progression.narrative: The performance opens on B3 and dwells most on B in Zang-e Shotor. The line peaks at B4 (497.3 Hz) at 0:41.2. It closes on Cs4, not the tonic (D#4 → B3 → B2 → Gs4 → B4 → Cs4).
